verdict_reason: all.sas7bdat (496 rows) holds options, decision, focus and session ids; after the script's 27 listed exclusions and the control-condition filter, 150 rows give chi2(1)=7.095, p=.0077, and the script's d formula gives .457, matching the table (p=.008, d=.46).

data_files.notes: SAS dataset, read with pyreadstat. This is the merged file the audit script reads (osf.io/c9z3d). Raw txt exports (sessions, sessionTasks, explicit, demographics, iat) also posted and downloaded; not opened beyond listing.
SAS build script from the raw txt files to all; also deletes 30 participants deemed aware of the study purpose.

key_test.test: Pearson chi-square without Yates correction, options (two vs ten pieces) x decision (confirming vs disconfirming), control-focus participants only, after excluding 27 listed session ids

obstacles: The script's d conversion is 2r/(1-r^2), not the usual 2r/sqrt(1-r^2) (which gives .446); the table value .46 follows the script's formula
R packages sas7bdat, gmodels, effsize not installed; not run in R
